title: KlimaTicket coverage rules for live journey legs (HAFAS/VAO/EFA)
disclaimer: Heuristic classification for the KlimaBilanz savings view – not legally binding. Authoritative scope per AGB 8.1: services shown by the BMIMI route planner route.bmk.gv.at (a VAO/HAFAS web app). When in doubt return 'unknown', never 'covered'.

resultEnum.surcharge: covered, plus an extra that is required (toll, night bus, berth) or optional (reservation, 1st class)
resultEnum.discount: not covered but discounted for ticket holders (CAT)
resultEnum.partial: covered only up to the border/Gemeinschaftsbahnhof

evaluation.order: Evaluate rules in ascending priority; first rule whose appliesTo includes the ticket family and whose match is true wins. appliesTo: 'oe' = KlimaTicket Ö (all variants incl. Familie/Bundesheer/Zivildienst/Freiwilligendienst), 'regional:<scope>' = regional product family, '*' = all.
evaluation.regionalTickets: For regional families first check regionalScopes[family].include/exclude (out of scope -> notCovered), then the '*' rules, then treat in-scope ÖV legs as covered.

matchOperators.clsAny: {scheme: [bits]} -> (cls & bit) != 0 for the leg's scheme only
matchOperators.anyStopOutsideAustria: any stop with country != AT that is not a Gemeinschaftsbahnhof
matchOperators.allStopsInAustriaOrGemeinschaftsbahnhof: every boarding/alighting stop (and passList stops with passenger exchange) is in AT or a Gemeinschaftsbahnhof
matchOperators.onTransitSection: leg path matches one of transitSections (by endpoint names)
matchOperators.boardAndAlightInAustria: leg.from and leg.to in AT (or Gemeinschaftsbahnhof)

evaluation.countryDetection: 1) ÖBB mgate locL[].countryCodeL (e.g. ['at'], ['de'], ['it'] – VERIFIED-LIVE in sibling fixtures; present on ~70 % of station objects, missing on VAO-instance responses). 2) Prefer explicit country / global id prefix ('at:', 'de:', 'ch:', 'it:', 'hu:', 'li:' ...) when the source provides one (EFA ids 'at:49:657', VAO altId 'at:44:41164:0:10'); else coordinates: match Gemeinschaftsbahnhöfe within 400 m, then point-in-polygon against an Austria outline; ÖBB EVA numbers are NOT reliable (Wien Hbf = 1290401, Salzburg Hbf = 8100002).

regionalScopes._howTo: For product family F (repo TicketProduct.id prefix) a leg is in scope iff scope.include matches and no scope.exclude matches; then the general exclusions (priority < 60 rules with appliesTo '*') still apply. Out-of-scope legs => result 'notCovered' with badge 'Nicht im {productName}'. stopState = federal state code of the stop from the app's StationIndex (Station.state: W, NÖ, OÖ, S, T, V, K, ST, B, X) – reverse-geocode coordinates if a stop is not in the index.

firstClassUpgradeAnnual.onlyOn: ÖBB-Strecken (Handbuch B.1.15.5: 'auf den Fahrtstrecken Ihres KlimaTickets Ö, die durch die ÖBB befahren werden'), Fernverkehr mit 1. Klasse

firstClassSingleTrip.rule: Klassenwechsel = Differenz 1./2. Klasse Standardticket für die Strecke (Handbuch B.1.1.7.2); −30 % mit KlimaTicket-Vorteilsabo (C.25.1.1.5). Read the amount from the shop offer if available, else derive from the offline Relationspreise table (1st minus 2nd class).

verbundTarifExklusivitaet.rule: Within one Verbund the regular single fare is the Verbund tariff, not the ÖBB Standardticket (Handbuch B.3.1.1.2: 'wird stets der jeweilige Verbundtarif angewandt'). The 'Normalpreis' shown for intra-Verbund trips must come from the Verbund tariff (VAO tariff output or offline Kernzone/Verbund tables).

ui._note: de-AT, Du-Form, Format.* for money ("€ 23,50"). Placeholders in {braces}. Choose by trip aggregate.

tripAggregation.covered: all ride legs covered (surcharges optional) -> 'Mit {ticketName}: € 0 · Normalpreis € {regular}'
tripAggregation.savingsRule: Break-even value of a trip = sum of regular prices of COVERED legs (2nd class, Standardticket or Verbund tariff) only; notCovered/partial-foreign parts add 0; required surcharges are costs the user paid anyway (do not subtract from savings, show separately).
